Houses for sale in Maryland with a maximum price of $60,000 on LandWatch (found at https://www.landwatch.com/maryland-land-for-sale/homes/price-under-60000):

1. **$50,000** • 1.5 acres
   - Address: 11139 Hodson White Road, Dames Quarter, MD 21821 (Somerset County)
   - Details: 1,440 sq. ft. solid brick construction church with hardwood floors, HVAC system, and an additional 0.75-acre lot included (2.25 acres total).

2. **$53,500** • 1 acre
   - Address: 29377 Lovers Lane, Marion, MD 21838 (Somerset County)
   - Details: Frame-built country church built in 1890 with conversion potential into a dwelling; large open sanctuary area with pine floors and beadboard vaulted ceiling.

3. **$60,000** • 1.1 acres
   - Address: 13518 BLANK Road NW, Mount Savage, MD 21545 (Allegany County)
   - Details: 3 beds • 4 baths • 2,413 sq. ft. ranch-style manufactured home with full basement and mountain views.

4. **$59,990** • 0.2 acres / 1,200 sq. ft.
   - Address: 1548 GRANT Road, Stockton, MD 21864 (Worcester County)
   - Details: 1 bed • 1 bath • 1,200 sq. ft. farmhouse in rural Stockton countryside.

5. **$44,000** • 1 acre
   - Address: 2603 Toddville Road, Toddville, MD 21672 (Dorchester County)
   - Details: 2 beds • 1 bath • 768 sq. ft. bungalow in Toddville water-oriented community with brand new architectural shingled roof.

6. **$49,000** • 1 acre
   - Address: 2603 Toddville Rd, Toddville, MD 21672 (Dorchester County)
   - Details: 2 beds • 1 bath • 768 sq. ft. bungalow/getaway or hunting/fishing cabin.
